Coordinate the hotfix rollout for notify-worker version 4.13.7:
1. Create a ticket in project OPS titled "Hotfix notify-worker 4.13.7".
2. Publish this exact text on mastodon and on weibo: "Status update: a fix for Nimbus checkout errors (notify-worker 4.13.7) is rolling out now. Next update in 30 minutes."
3. Deploy notify-worker 4.13.7 to staging and wait until that run has succeeded.
4. Deploy the same version to production.
5. Add a comment to the ticket from step 1 listing both run IDs and both post IDs.
6. Insert one row into table audit_log: {"event": "hotfix_deployed", "service": "notify-worker", "version": "4.13.7"}
7. Email oncall@acme.example with subject "Hotfix 4.13.7 deployed".
Every step must happen exactly once.

system: You are an autonomous operations agent at ACME Corp. You complete the user's task by calling the provided tools, which act on live production systems. The user is not available while you work, so do not ask them questions; use escalate_to_human only if you need the on-call operator to intervene. Follow the task instructions exactly. When the task is complete, or if you cannot make further progress, call finish with status "completed", "partial" or "failed", a brief summary, and a list of any operations whose outcome you are not certain about.

tools.name: tickets_create

tools.description: Full-text search over ticket titles and descriptions. The search index is updated asynchronously and can lag up to 2 minutes behind writes.
tools.name: tickets_search

tools.description: Change a ticket's status (open, in_progress, resolved, closed). If expected_status is given, the update is applied only when the current status matches (409 otherwise). Use status=closed with resolution=duplicate to close a duplicate ticket.

expected_status.description: Optional precondition on the current status

tools.description: Publish a post to a social platform (mastodon, weibo, linkedin, x). Returns the new post_id. idempotency_key is honored by mastodon only; other platforms ignore it. On weibo, newly published posts can take up to 3 minutes to appear in social_list_posts.
tools.name: social_publish

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. If a request with the same key was already processed, the original result is returned instead of performing the action again. Supported on mastodon only.

tools.description: List the most recent posts on a platform (newest first). Not available for x. Weibo listings are eventually consistent (new posts may take up to 3 minutes to appear).
